current_context.highest_confirmed_used_for_context: MoM-z14, z_spec=14.44, below the z>=20 trigger
current_context.do_not_count_as_confirmation: Any post-hoc z<20 agreement or photometric-only z>=20 candidate

confirm.condition: At least one spectroscopically confirmed mature galaxy at z >= 20
confirm.maturity_cut: stellar_mass_msun >= 1e8 OR M_UV <= -19.5 with non-AGN-dominated spectrum

strong_confirm.condition: At least one spectroscopically confirmed mature galaxy at z >= 25
strong_confirm.maturity_cut: stellar_mass_msun >= 1e8 OR M_UV <= -19.5 with non-AGN-dominated spectrum

fail_closed.condition: Sufficient JWST/Roman spectroscopy covers the expected survey volume and finds no mature galaxies at z >= 18
fail_closed.note: Survey volume threshold must be specified before applying this fail condition to a named survey.
